note: Word Hoard identity. uids are immutable and never reused. A uid that changes across builds is a bug. COMMIT THIS FILE -- it is the single home for this class of fact, and losing it silently renames every identifier in the Word Hoard. Natural key is the citation string; kind is NOT part of it.
reserved_note: reserved: uids minted for private records whose citations live outside this public repo (the Word Hoard house, data/uids/house.uids.json). Listed bare -- a uid says nothing -- so no mint here can ever reuse one. Never remove an entry.
